name: vps-one-cloudflare
description: Self-contained Cloudflare Workers deployment for VPS-ONE with D1, Queues, Cron Triggers, and Worker Assets.

ASSETS.description: Static VPS-ONE admin and customer interface served by this Worker.

DB.description: D1 stores users, plans, orders, wallets, encrypted provider configuration, jobs, and audit data. Migrations are applied automatically during deployment.

JOBS.description: Queue used for provisioning, email delivery, payment processing, and retryable background jobs.

SECRET_KEY.description: Generate a unique random value of at least 32 bytes. It peppers password hashes and signs security tokens; changing it invalidates existing passwords.

MASTER_KEY.description: Generate a different random value of at least 32 bytes. It encrypts CLICD tokens, HashPay keys, card inventory, and instance credentials. Losing it makes encrypted data unrecoverable.

ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN.description: A one-time random token used on the first-run setup screen to create the administrator account.

RESEND_API_TOKEN.description: Resend API token used for instance credentials, digital delivery, refund codes, and test email.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Verified Resend sender, for example VPS-ONE <noreply@example.com>.

scripts.dev: npm run build && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs dev --local --persist-to .wrangler/state
scripts.db:migrate:local: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy --keep-vars
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build && node scripts/run-wrangler.mjs deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run
scripts.deploy:pages: wrangler pages deploy pages/dist --project-name vps-one-cf-beta --config pages/wrangler.generated.toml
